# 🧩 Documentation templates

Use these templates to keep project decisions and changes reviewable.

- [Architecture Decision Record](adr.md)
- [Feature proposal](feature-proposal.md)
- [Bug report](bug-report.md)
- [Test plan](test-plan.md)
- [Risk register](risk-register.md)
- [Incident report](incident-report.md)
- [Release notes](release-notes.md)

Copy the relevant template into the appropriate issue, pull request, or docs location. Remove prompts that do not apply and replace every placeholder before submitting.
